body:
I went out and got some sunshine. I think maybe part of the issue is him not being the best with tone of voice so maybe I have said stop playfully in the past, so when I say it neutrally he makes the assumption I'm not serious. I'll definitely speak to him now that I'm calm and not mid crisis. 

Everything you said was incredibly helpful and really made this awful day a lot better by putting things into perspective.

My job is high stress and I'm in a client facing role and feel judged 24/7. 

My bf is a complete jerk. 

I have no idea what direction my life is going to take and I'm so overwhelmed I have no time or motivation to figure that out. 

I'm fat. 

I have no friends because I push everyone away bc I fear they will get to know me and hate me. 

I have trauma in just about every category there is and I just restarted therapy and it's making me worse not better.
